name: The Oryza
summary: The Oryza exists in Sector 88A on Dwarka Expressway, with HARERA number GGM/1043/775/2026/15. The developer is Origen Realty, but we publish null. Possession in 2033 matches (most sources say Sept 2033). Sources disagree on land, towers and units: 8.26 acres, 2 towers and 344 units (Phase 1) vs 8.2 acres, 5 towers and 478 units. A price (~Rs 3.5-3.65 Cr) and 3 BHK sizes are available online, but we publish neither.
